# Potomac Green

> Landscaping and light handyman services for homeowners in Potomac, Bethesda, Rockville and Silver Spring, Maryland. Established 2026. One local contact for the yard and the small jobs around the house.

## Contact
- Phone, text or WhatsApp: 301-674-9361
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/13016749361
- Email: potomacservice@gmail.com
- Typical hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.

## Service area
- Core towns: Potomac (20854), Bethesda, Rockville, Silver Spring, Maryland
- Also nearby Montgomery County communities, depending on the job and schedule
- Service-area business. No street address or storefront.

## Services
- Flowerbed Prep & Planting: prepare beds, place new flowers and shrubs, refresh existing garden areas.
- Trimming & Hedging: shape shrubs and hedges, clean up overgrown plantings.
- Mulch & Lawn Care: mulch installation, basic lawn upkeep, edging, cleanup, seasonal refresh.
- Decorative Plants: selection and placement help for plants, pots and outdoor accents.
- Planter Construction: simple custom planters and raised planting solutions for patios, yards and entries.
- Furniture Assembly: indoor and outdoor furniture and household items.
- Moving Help: furniture, boxes, planters and other manageable items around the property.
- Light Handyman Tasks: small, non-specialty household tasks that do not require a licensed trade contractor.
- And more: have a different small job? Send a photo and a short description to see whether it is a fit.

## How it works
1. Describe the job: call, text or WhatsApp with the location, your task list and preferred timing.
2. Send photos: photos show the size and condition of the yard, furniture, planter or work area.
3. Confirm and schedule: scope, estimate and timing are agreed before the work begins.

## Good to know
- Small jobs welcome. A practical option when a large contractor is unnecessary.
- One-time projects and recurring upkeep.
- Clear limits when a job requires a licensed specialist. Electrical, plumbing, roofing, HVAC and gas work are outside the scope.
